name: HappyFox
description: HappyFox is a full-stack AI support platform offering help desk ticketing, an AI-powered chatbot, a service desk for IT teams, and workflow automation for customer and internal support.
best_for: Customer service and IT/HR teams from small businesses to enterprises across education, healthcare, ecommerce, and real estate needing omnichannel support at scale.
features: AI-powered help desk ticketing with knowledge base
Autopilot AI agents for automating repetitive support tasks
Service desk module for IT incident and asset tracking
AI contact center with voice AI
Integrations with Slack, Microsoft Teams, Salesforce, Jira, and Shopify

tiers.name: Help Desk
tiers.notes: Core ticketing product; entry price. Annual billing saves 20%.

tiers.name: Service Desk
tiers.notes: IT/internal service desk product; incident and asset tracking.

tiers.name: Contact Center Suite
tiers.notes: Complete CCaaS bundle, one price. All AI products included with no additional per-seat AI fees.

tiers.name: Chatbot (usage-based AI)
tiers.notes: Separately metered AI product, billed per resolution rather than per seat.

tiers.name: Autopilot (usage-based AI)
tiers.notes: "Pay as low as 2 cents per successful action" -- a second, separately metered usage-based AI product.

alternatives.name: Zendesk
alternatives.description: A customer service platform with ticketing, live chat, and AI-powered automation.
alternatives.best_for: Support teams of all sizes needing an established, feature-rich helpdesk.

alternatives.name: Freshdesk
alternatives.description: A cloud-based help desk with ticketing, automation, and omnichannel support.
alternatives.best_for: Support teams wanting an affordable, easy-to-deploy helpdesk.

alternatives.name: Help Scout
alternatives.description: A shared inbox and help desk platform built for personalized, human-feeling support.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized support teams wanting simple, email-centric ticketing.

alternatives.name: Zoho Desk
alternatives.description: An AI-powered customer service platform that unifies support conversations across channels into one inbox, with a Zia AI assistant that handles routine tickets autonomously.
alternatives.best_for: Customer-first businesses wanting unified multichannel ticketing with AI automation
